name: Assistants API v2 (beta)
summary: OpenAI Assistants v2 exposes `model` in four places: POST /v1/assistants, PATCH /v1/assistants/{id}, POST /v1/threads/{id}/runs (override), POST /v1/threads/runs (override).
description: The Assistants v2 beta API stores a default model on `POST /v1/assistants` / `PATCH /v1/assistants/{id}` and can override it on `POST /v1/threads/{thread_id}/runs` / `POST /v1/threads/runs`. Those model slots would need to carry `{connection}/{deployment}` for legacy assistant users to route through APIM AI Gateway instead of a local Foundry deployment.
notes: Not yet probed against Foundry with a captured server response. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/assistants/methods/create. See `test.py` for the create-assistant and run wiring; Prompt Agents (`prompt-agents-static` / `prompt-agents-dynamic`) are the recommended Foundry successor.
